 def truncate(text: str, n: int) -> str:
-    """Cut to at most n characters, ending with an ellipsis when cut."""
-    return text if len(text) <= n else text[: n - 1] + "…"
+    """Cut to at most n characters at a word boundary, ending with an ellipsis.
+
+    A single word longer than the limit is still cut mid-word.
+    """
+    if len(text) <= n:
+        return text
+    head = text[: n - 1]
+    if not text[n - 1].isspace():
+        cut = head.rfind(" ")
+        if cut > 0:
+            head = head[:cut]
+    return head.rstrip() + "…"
